location.directions_summary: Main Market Road par, City Hospital ke theek samne, doosri manzil par

pricing.payment_modes: Cash and UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)

emergency.emergency_protocol: Ye emergency lag rahi hai, please turant nearest hospital emergency room ya 108 par call karein.

faqs.parking: Haan, clinic ke basement mein free parking suvidha uplabdh hai.
faqs.insurance: OPD consultation ke liye direct cash ya UPI payment hoti hai, aur reimbursement bill diya jata hai.
faqs.reports: Pichhli test reports ya medicines aap clinic aate waqt sath la sakte hain.
faqs.eye_checkup: Haan, clinic par aankh ka number aur vision screening ki suvidha uplabdh hai.
